items.title: 70980_Quinn Wilson oral history interview
items.q: The interviewee confirms the location was associated with Capone's gang ('Yeah. They started fading out in later years. Yeah. after Capone got busted.'), but there is no evidence of a personal relationship between Quinn Wilson and Al Capone.

ctx.x: The Syndicate, yeah, the Syndicate. The Syndicate. See, but when the government started cracking up on the books and things, then they just gave it -- they gave the joint to Ed Fox.
